title: Soft as Dreams
description: Soft as Dreams is a curated body of work focused on the visual rhythm of the human body, physical expression, and movement. Rendered in a signature color palette dominated by luminous pinks and grounding greens, the collection explores the body as a site of emotional dialogue, freedom, and vulnerability. Stripped of rigid spatial boundaries, the figures leap, yield, and suspend in mid-motion, translating internal states into fluid visual gestures. The vibrant contrast between pink and green forms an energetic dialogue - balancing softness with pulse, tension with liberation. Rooted in contemporary love discourse and tactile memory, this selection celebrates bodily expression as a quiet, dreamlike sanctuary where physical forms become pure emotion.
